```{r}
hsskin.immune <- FindClusters(object = hsskin.immune, resolution = 2.0)


marker_immune <- list(
  "CD14+"   = c("CD14"), #monocyte
  "CD68+" = c("CD68"),
  "CD4+ CXCR3+/FOXP3+" = c("CD3E", "CD4", "TBX21", "CXCR3", "FOXP3"), #Th1 / Treg
  "CD8+" = c("CD8A"),
  "CD45+" = c("PTPRC")
)

Idents(hsskin.immune) <- 'SCT_snn_res.1'

DotPlot(hsskin.immune, features = marker_immune) + 
  # 1. Flip the plot so cell types are on the Y-axis and genes on X
  #coord_flip() + 
  # 2. Rotate gene names 45 degrees
  RotatedAxis() +
  # 3. Fine-tune text size and plot margins
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),      # Size of the "Basal_K" labels
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),       # Size of the Gene labels
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6), 
    # Optional: reduce the angle or adjust spacing if they still overlap
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)        # Adds extra space around the plot
  )

#seems like immune cell_3 consists of both Th1+ and CD8+ cells 
#immune cell_2 consists of CD14+ (monocytes) and CD68+ (myeloid-macrophages)

DimPlot(hsskin.ST, reduction = "umap", group.by = "immune_subclusters", label = TRUE, label.size = 3)
```

```{r}

hsskin.ST$age <- factor(hsskin.ST$age, levels = c("Young", "Old"))


immsen3 <- as.data.frame(table(hsskin.ST$sample, hsskin.ST$immune_subclusters1))

cells <- as.data.frame(immsen3 %>%
                           group_by(Var1) %>%
                           mutate(Freq = Freq / sum(Freq)))
cells <- cells[cells$Var2 != 'none',]
# cells <- cells[cells$Var2 != 'CD45+',]

cells <- cells %>%
  group_by(Var1) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round(Freq * 100, 1))  # Convert proportion to percentage

library(ggplot2)

stacked_barplot <- ggplot(cells, aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") +  # Black borders
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percentage, "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 2, color = "black") +  # Percentage labels inside bars
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Cell Types in Young vs. Old",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Cell Types"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Display the plot
print(stacked_barplot)
```
